Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-view` (`view-config-utils.ts:324` + the stale-spelling fixture noted on the card); routed `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, type Task. Ruling inheritance (no new adjudication needed): #4869's recorded ruling — a spelling the sink doesn't recognise gets ruled into the contract or rejected at the producer, never absorbed by a tolerance layer — is quoted verbatim by this card and applies without modification; #5293 just executed the same retirement for the `views[].sort` path and shipped it as a `minor` with a loud changeset per AGENTS.md's versioning policy. Inherit: **option 1** (remove the `|| s.direction` fallback), same treatment — changeset names the retired spelling so the break is searchable, which also completes #5293's "loud and searchable" promise. The out-of-tree-caller unknown is priced by that policy (objectui ships its own breaks as minor), not a reason to keep the tolerant read. Clause-②: **yes** (published-export acceptance change) — contract-review tier applies at claim. The SortUI file-local `toSortItems` is a different symbol — leave it.

## Claimed + dispatched — `domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat

PM session `session_01CSoz9uGhaaSgiq3hshtN7L`, branch `claude/issue-6011-tosortitems-direction`.
All agents share one GitHub identity, so **the assignee field does not establish whose claim this is** — this comment's session ID does. No earlier claim comment exists on this card.

### 裁决 (binding — the ruling is INHERITED, not newly made)

**Option 1: remove the `|| s.direction` fallback.** One spelling repo-wide, declared equals enforced.

This needs no fresh adjudication and you must not re-open it. #4869's recorded ruling — *a spelling the sink doesn't recognise gets ruled into the contract or rejected at the producer, never absorbed by a tolerance layer* — is quoted verbatim on the card and applies unmodified. #5293 executed the identical retirement for the `views[].sort` path days ago and shipped it as a **`minor`** with a loud changeset per AGENTS.md 版本号策略. You inherit that treatment exactly.

**The out-of-tree-caller unknown is already priced.** The card is right that the honest answer is not derivable from this repo — and objectui's stated policy is that it ships its own breaks as `minor`. That policy *is* the answer. ⛔ It is not a reason to keep the tolerant read, and ⛔ it is not a question to escalate back to me.

**Changeset: `minor`.** ⛔ Never `major`. It must **name the retired `direction` spelling in words**, so a host greping the old key finds the break — that is what completes #5293's "loud and searchable" promise, and it is the deliverable, not decoration.

### PM机制假设 (verify — the card names a trap that a naive grep walks straight into)

1. `packages/plugin-view/src/config/view-config-utils.ts:324-330` is the definition. **Re-derive the line numbers** — every card this round has drifted 6–150 lines.
2. It is genuinely published: re-exported at `packages/plugin-view/src/index.tsx:38`, documented at `packages/plugin-view/README.md:91`. Confirm both, and **update the README line if it describes the tolerated spelling**.
3. ⚠️ **`packages/plugin-view/src/SortUI.tsx:58/:81/:86` declares a DIFFERENT, file-local `const toSortItems`.** It shadows nothing, imports nothing, and maps `SortEntry[]` whose `direction` key is **type-correct** on `SortUISchema`. It is **not** a caller of the published export. ⛔ **Leave it entirely alone.** A grep for `toSortItems` reads it as a caller and it is not one — triage says so explicitly.
4. The only importer of the published symbol is a test: `apps/console/src/__tests__/insecure-origin-crypto.test.ts:20/:226/:244`. Verify, and check whether it depends on the tolerant read.

### PM建议路线 (advisory — overrule with measurement and say so)

The card records a **related stale-spelling fixture** at `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.filterSources.test.tsx:161-162`, which writes `direction` behind an `as any` on a `table.defaultSort` surface that declares **`order`** (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts:673-676`, zod mirror agreeing). It stays green only because that assertion pins **verbatim pass-through** — it never reads the key, so any word passes.

The card says it "should be re-spelled by whoever takes this card," and I agree **with one condition**: re-spell it only if re-spelling does **not** preserve the shape of a bug the test was written to catch. Read what the test is actually for before touching it. If re-spelling would change what it pins, leave it and file the finding instead.

### Clause-② — contract-review tier applies

This is a **published-export acceptance change**: an out-of-tree caller passing `{ field, direction }` goes from a working `SortItem` to a silent `'asc'`. Triage flagged Clause-② at claim, so the PR body must carry the contract-review content — what the export accepted before, what it accepts after, and the exact failure mode of an unmigrated caller, stated in those terms.

### Standing verification rules (non-negotiable)

Predict direction before running. Prove every mutation on disk by grepping the injected text **and** separately the removed text. Print the landing site. Assert anchor uniqueness bounded to the right span. Restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM` with a cwd-independent command; confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` is empty afterwards. Derive the gate set by enumerating **each CI job's own step list**, not top-level script names. A cached turbo green is not a measurement — use `--force`. Commit before you ablate.

⚠️ **The trap specific to this card:** the function has **no in-repo production caller**, so a pin that merely calls `toSortItems` and checks the result is testing a function nothing uses — that is fine and correct here, but it means your ablation cannot rely on any existing suite going red. Write the pin first, prove it red against the unfixed function, then fix.

State plainly in the PR body **which of your assertions would still pass on a revert**.

### Collision bounds

Four sibling agents are live this wave on `packages/i18n` + i18n call sites, `packages/plugin-gantt`, `packages/plugin-form`, and `packages/components/src/renderers/form/radio-group.tsx`. `packages/plugin-view` is yours alone. Report any overlap rather than editing across it.

⛔ Leave the PR **draft**. Do not mark ready, do not enqueue, do not enable auto-merge — the PM lands it.

### Notes for the PM that do not fit the schema

- **Clause ② content is in the PR body** — what the export accepted before (`s.order || s.direction || 'asc'`, two spellings for one key), what it accepts after (`order` only), and the exact failure mode of an unmigrated caller (`{ field, direction }` → a rendered, silently **ascending** `SortItem`, nothing thrown or warned). The TypeScript signature is byte-identical before and after, so this is an acceptance change with no compile-time witness on either side — which is why the changeset is the only migration signal a host gets.
- **Which assertions survive a revert** is stated in the PR body as a table: 2 of 6 grade the retirement, 4 are regression cover for the deliberately-untouched behaviour and stay green on a revert, as does every other suite in the repo.
- **The advisory fixture was re-spelled, with the condition checked first.** `ObjectView.filterSources.test.tsx` pins *verbatim pass-through* and never reads the direction key, so re-spelling `direction` → `order` changes nothing it grades. I left its **arity** alone (it passes an array where `defaultSort` declares a single object) and recorded why in a comment there — that arity is the substance of finding #6235, and changing it inside this PR would have been an undeclared edit to what the test pins.
- **One tension I did not resolve unilaterally:** `.changeset/5293-view-sort-order-spelling.md` still says this export was not retired *in that release*. If both changesets ship in the same release, that sentence reads as contradicting mine. I did **not** edit another card's changeset; instead my entry states explicitly that #5293's scope note described that release's scope correctly and is superseded here. If you'd rather the #5293 entry be amended at release-compile time, that is your call, not mine.
- **No sibling overlap.** The diff is 6 files, all in `packages/plugin-view` plus its changeset; nothing in `packages/i18n`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-form`, or `components/.../radio-group.tsx`. Working tree contained only my own files at commit time.
- **CI not waited on**, per the dispatch contract — PR is draft at `b0d186b79` and `mergeable_state` was `behind` at creation (base moved to `2ecc9c7cb` while I worked); no rebase attempted, that is yours to land.
